# Configuration reference (`pcbtestkit.json`)

`pcbtestkit.json` sits next to the KiCad project and only holds what differs from the defaults below. The KiCad dialog, the CLI options and the AI write tools all edit this file (writes add an `_audit` entry). `pcbtestkit init <project>` writes a starting template. Commit it with the design.

## `schema_version`



```json
{
  "schema_version": 1
}
```

## `fab_profile`

Baseline manufacturing limits: standard | advanced | conservative. A technology class (tech) overrides it.

```json
{
  "fab_profile": "standard"
}
```

## `fab_overrides`

Individual fab limits in mm, e.g. {"min_track": 0.1}.

```json
{
  "fab_overrides": {}
}
```

## `tech`

Fab class system and the class you order; extra class checks; board context (finish, copper, mask colour).

```json
{
  "tech": {
    "system": null,
    "class": null,
    "layers": null,
    "base_copper_um": null,
    "context": {},
    "checks": [],
    "systems_dirs": [],
    "systems": {},
    "table": null,
    "tables": {}
  }
}
```

## `analysis`

Waivers, ignored checks and thresholds for the weak-point analysis.

```json
{
  "analysis": {
    "edge_mlcc_mm": 3.0,
    "edge_component_mm": 0.5,
    "decoupling_max_mm": 5.0,
    "heat_distance_mm": 10.0,
    "tall_component_mm": 15.0,
    "power_min_track_mm": 0.3,
    "temperature_rise_c": 10.0,
    "cap_derating": {
      "ceramic": 0.5,
      "electrolytic": 0.8,
      "tantalum": 0.5,
      "other": 0.8
    },
    "resistor_derating": 0.5,
    "mounting_hole_flex_mm": 3.0,
    "large_board_mm2": 2500.0,
    "acid_trap_deg": 80.0,
    "run_kicad_drc": true,
    "run_kicad_erc": true,
    "ignore_checks": [],
    "ignore_refs": [],
    "waivers": [],
    "max_items_per_finding": 25
  }
}
```

## `nets`

Per-net expectations: nominal + tolerance_pct or min/max (volts), kind, test: false to skip.

```json
{
  "nets": {}
}
```

## `supply`

How the tester powers the board: net, voltage, current limit and the expected idle-current window.

```json
{
  "supply": {
    "net": null,
    "voltage": null,
    "current_limit_a": 0.5,
    "max_idle_current_a": null,
    "min_idle_current_a": null
  }
}
```

## `testplan`

Probe side, pogo family and mounting, signal policy, channel budget, ADC range, timing.

```json
{
  "testplan": {
    "probe_side": "auto",
    "pogo": "P75",
    "pogo_mount": "receptacle",
    "pogo_drill_mm": null,
    "signals": "auto",
    "include_nets": [],
    "exclude_nets": [],
    "max_channels": 32,
    "edge_keepout_mm": 1.5,
    "min_target_mm": null,
    "allow_vias": false,
    "allow_component_pads": true,
    "gnd_points": 2,
    "supply_points": 2,
    "default_tolerance_pct": 5.0,
    "signal_tolerance_v": 0.15,
    "adc_max_v": 3.3,
    "max_signal_voltage": null,
    "probe_clearance_mm": 6.0,
    "short_test_min_ohm": 100.0,
    "settle_ms": 500,
    "fine_pitch_exclude_mm": 0.8,
    "custom_steps": [],
    "manual_checks": []
  }
}
```

## `fixture`

Fixture PCB outline, margins, N x M panel, mounting holes, dividers.

```json
{
  "fixture": {
    "outline": "rect",
    "margin_mm": 8.0,
    "panel": {
      "cols": 1,
      "rows": 1,
      "spacing_mm": 10.0
    },
    "mounting_holes": true,
    "mounting_hole_d_mm": 3.2,
    "dividers": true,
    "divider_r_bottom_rail": 10000.0,
    "divider_r_bottom_signal": 100000.0,
    "draw_dut_components": true,
    "cut_tall_components": true
  }
}
```

## `jig`

Solder-jig parts (auto = all THT), pocket clearances and depths, part heights by ref.

```json
{
  "jig": {
    "parts": "auto",
    "exclude": [],
    "relief_all_top": true,
    "resolution_mm": 0.25,
    "hold_clearance_mm": 0.25,
    "relief_clearance_mm": 0.8,
    "relief_extra_depth_mm": 1.0,
    "hold_depth_offset_mm": 0.1,
    "floor_mm": 2.0,
    "rim_mm": 3.0,
    "rim_height_mm": 1.2,
    "edge_clearance_mm": 0.3,
    "posts": true,
    "post_clearance_mm": 0.2,
    "finger_notches": true,
    "heights": {}
  }
}
```

## `video`

Explainer video: real 3D animation on/off, frame rate, size, parallel renders, render quality.

```json
{
  "video": {
    "animate": true,
    "fps": 24,
    "width": 1280,
    "height": 720,
    "workers": 0,
    "quality": "basic"
  }
}
```

## `outputs`

Which files a run writes by default.

```json
{
  "outputs": {
    "spec": true,
    "testplan": true,
    "fixture": true,
    "jig": true,
    "report": true,
    "runner": true,
    "guide": true,
    "visuals": true,
    "video": false,
    "keep_scenes": false
  }
}
```

## Fab profiles

Limits (mm) behind `fab_profile`; a technology class replaces them.

```json
{
  "standard": {
    "min_track": 0.127,
    "min_clearance": 0.127,
    "min_drill": 0.3,
    "min_via_annular": 0.1,
    "min_tht_annular": 0.15,
    "min_edge_clearance": 0.3,
    "min_hole_to_hole": 0.25,
    "max_aspect_ratio": 8.0,
    "warn_factor": 1.25
  },
  "advanced": {
    "min_track": 0.09,
    "min_clearance": 0.09,
    "min_drill": 0.2,
    "min_via_annular": 0.075,
    "min_tht_annular": 0.125,
    "min_edge_clearance": 0.25,
    "min_hole_to_hole": 0.2,
    "max_aspect_ratio": 10.0,
    "warn_factor": 1.2
  },
  "conservative": {
    "min_track": 0.2,
    "min_clearance": 0.2,
    "min_drill": 0.35,
    "min_via_annular": 0.15,
    "min_tht_annular": 0.25,
    "min_edge_clearance": 0.5,
    "min_hole_to_hole": 0.4,
    "max_aspect_ratio": 6.0,
    "warn_factor": 1.3
  }
}
```

## Pogo families

```json

  "P50": {
    "pitch": 1.27,
    "drill_direct": 0.75,
    "drill_receptacle": 0.9,
    "min_target": 0.6,
    "pad_extra": 0.4
  },
  "P75": {
    "pitch": 1.91,
    "drill_direct": 1.1,
    "drill_receptacle": 1.4,
    "min_target": 0.9,
    "pad_extra": 0.5
  },
  "P100": {
    "pitch": 2.54,
    "drill_direct": 1.45,
    "drill_receptacle": 1.7,
    "min_target": 1.0,
    "pad_extra": 0.6
  }
}
```
